name: Silver Pieces
description: A purse of silver coins, the coin of the school town.

name: Charms
description: The study of small, useful magic: lighting a room, mending a tear, lifting a latch, and making the everyday bend without breaking. You gain +1 when charms are the heart of the attempt, and you may learn Charms spells.

effects.text: +1 to Charms rolls; may learn Charms spells.

name: Transfiguration
description: The study of changing one thing into another: shape, material, size, and the stubbornness of matter. You gain +1 when transfiguration is the heart of the attempt, and you may learn Transfiguration spells.

effects.text: +1 to Transfiguration rolls; may learn Transfiguration spells.

name: Warding
description: The study of boundaries, locks, alarms, and the things that should not cross them. You gain +1 when warding is the heart of the attempt, and you may learn Warding spells.

effects.text: +1 to Warding rolls; may learn Warding spells.

name: Divination
description: The study of glimpses, omens, lost things, and answers that arrive sideways. You gain +1 when divination is the heart of the attempt, and you may learn Divination spells.

effects.text: +1 to Divination rolls; may learn Divination spells.

name: Healing
description: The study of mending bodies, calming minds, and keeping someone alive until help arrives. You gain +1 when healing is the heart of the attempt, and you may learn Healing spells.

effects.text: +1 to Healing rolls; may learn Healing spells.

name: Illusion
description: The study of false doors, borrowed faces, quiet feet, and scenes that are not there. You gain +1 when illusion is the heart of the attempt, and you may learn Illusion spells.

effects.text: +1 to Illusion rolls; may learn Illusion spells.

name: Elemental
description: The study of flame, air, water, stone, and weather, and the bargains they demand. You gain +1 when elemental magic is the heart of the attempt, and you may learn Elemental spells.

effects.text: +1 to Elemental rolls; may learn Elemental spells.

name: Theory Training (Early Years)
description: Early-years study sharpens your grasp of theory. Raise Theory by 1, up to +2.

name: Practice Training (Early Years)
description: Early-years drills sharpen your casting. Raise Practice by 1, up to +2.

name: Alchemy Training (Early Years)
description: Early-years lab work steadies your hands. Raise Alchemy by 1, up to +2.

name: Charm Training (Early Years)
description: Early-years social practice makes you harder to rattle. Raise Charm by 1, up to +2.

name: Cunning Training (Early Years)
description: Early-years trouble teaches you the back ways. Raise Cunning by 1, up to +2.

name: Theory Training (Middle Years)
description: Middle-years study sharpens your grasp of theory. Raise Theory by 1, up to +3.

name: Practice Training (Middle Years)
description: Middle-years drills sharpen your casting. Raise Practice by 1, up to +3.

name: Alchemy Training (Middle Years)
description: Middle-years lab work steadies your hands. Raise Alchemy by 1, up to +3.

name: Charm Training (Middle Years)
description: Middle-years social practice makes you harder to rattle. Raise Charm by 1, up to +3.

name: Cunning Training (Middle Years)
description: Middle-years trouble teaches you the back ways. Raise Cunning by 1, up to +3.

name: Theory Training (Final Years)
description: Final-years study sharpens your grasp of theory. Raise Theory by 1, up to +4.

name: Practice Training (Final Years)
description: Final-years drills sharpen your casting. Raise Practice by 1, up to +4.

name: Alchemy Training (Final Years)
description: Final-years lab work steadies your hands. Raise Alchemy by 1, up to +4.

name: Charm Training (Final Years)
description: Final-years social practice makes you harder to rattle. Raise Charm by 1, up to +4.

name: Cunning Training (Final Years)
description: Final-years trouble teaches you the back ways. Raise Cunning by 1, up to +4.

name: Natural Gift
description: Once per week, when a spell you cast rolls a 6-, treat it as a 7-9 instead. The magic arrives late, sideways, or larger than you meant.

effects.text: Once per week, turn a spell's 6- into a 7-9.

reactions.text: Natural Gift turns the 6- into a 7-9.

name: Well Read
description: When you research from a text, add +1. You always know where a text you have seen is kept, even if it is not where it belongs.

effects.text: +1 to research from a text; you know where texts are kept.

name: Portable Lab
description: You carry a compact kit of reagents and tools. Add +1 when you improvise a potion or transmutation without a proper laboratory.

name: Slippery
description: Add +1 when you break curfew, slip past a prefect, or leave a place you should not be. You know one hidden route through the school.

effects.text: +1 to breaking curfew and slipping away; know one hidden route.

name: Connections
description: Add +1 when you ask a favor through a friend, a rival, or a family name. You know someone who owes you a small favor.

effects.text: +1 to favors; know someone who owes you.

name: Signature Spell
description: You have a personal spell, written in your Signature Spell field. When you cast it, describe its unmistakable flourish. Once per week, treat a 6- on it as a 7-9.

effects.text: Once per week, turn your signature spell's 6- into a 7-9.

reactions.text: Signature Spell turns the 6- into a 7-9.
